source_basis.mapping_rule: One selected source task maps to exactly one source_task turn.

agent_input.workspace_persistence: Reuse the same writable workspace for all turns in this stream; reset only when the declared evaluation condition requires it.

Mission cards: many missions have you draw a card. Some cards give choices.  
Missions cost energy equal to tier

Cards are worth points per Tier.

Replace “faceup Tier I card” with Tier I field.  
Capitalize “Spacecat” and “Spaceship”  
Card assignment tokens  
Cards that avoid attacks: Deploy: discard to avoid an attack  
Take energy costs into account  
Mischief cards in Operations

Game ends when Tier III cards are gone?

Maybe symbols before each deployment effect that determines if it is one use (X), upon deployment (down arrow), or ongoing (infinity)

Play Order:  
Play cards for effect, income, or deployment (up to one)  
Purchase up to one card  
Complete up to one mission

Abilities from missions?  
Missions require a Spaceship for completion  
Three Spaceship deployment slots  
Card effects that say “Deploy” are an additional deployment.  
Depletion Tokens for “One Use” effects

Make missions easier. Maybe they require a total strength, and tier II cards contribute to that.  
Maybe you don’t start with useless cats, unless you do?  
Separate spaceships, permanent piles?  
Spaceships can be deployed once purchased, or go into your discard for drawing.  
Get rid of energy?  
Cards that double other incomes  
Perhaps you can only spend income you get that round. Won’t be indecisive saving up for later.

Simplify, maybe get rid of energy, simplify temporary credits

\-less reserve cards, less deployed cards

Reserve Credits: credits you can save up

\-Tier 1 Focus Operations: change to "Choose a color, gain 2 credits per card played"   
\-Recall Deployed cards abilities or action

Dismissing cards is too powerful: minimize, put them in only Tier II?   
\-Increase mission rewards

\-Event deck you draw before a mission?

\-Get rid of energy or make it easier to get. Discard cards for energy? 

Boost Mission VP

Remove many Operations

Lower costs

Add starter operation that refreshes cards

Only deal out a few missions per game

**Rules:**  
\-No limit on buys each turn  
\-Deploy only 1 card per turn

Mission cards: export at 10” tall, size to page at 26%
